request.query: Every real algebraic number has a positive natural number multiple that is an algebraic integer

items.name: IsAlgebraic.exists_integral_multiple
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] {z : A},
  IsAlgebraic R z → ∃ y, y ≠ 0 ∧ IsIntegral R (y • z)

items.name: IsAlgebraic.nsmul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] {a : A},
  IsAlgebraic R a → ∀ (n : ℕ), IsAlgebraic R (n • a)

items.name: exists_integral_multiples
items.type:
∀ (A : Type u_1) (K : Type u_2) [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
  {L : Type u_3} [inst_4 : Field L] [inst_5 : Algebra K L] [inst_6 : Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
  [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsDomain A] (s : Finset L), ∃ y, y ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, IsIntegral A (y • x)

items.name: Algebra.IsAlgebraic.exists_integral_multiples
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u_1) {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] [NoZeroDivisors R]
  [alg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic R A] (s : Finset A), ∃ y, y ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ z ∈ s, IsIntegral R (y • z)

items.name: IsAlgebraic.zsmul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] {a : A},
  IsAlgebraic R a → ∀ (n : ℤ), IsAlgebraic R (n • a)

items.name: IsIntegral.nsmul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {B : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring B] [inst_2 : Algebra R B] {x : B},
  IsIntegral R x → ∀ (n : ℕ), IsIntegral R (n • x)

items.name: isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u} {A : Type v} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Ring A] [inst_2 : Algebra K A] {x : A},
  IsAlgebraic K x ↔ IsIntegral K x

items.name: IsAlgebraic.isIntegral
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u} {A : Type v} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Ring A] [inst_2 : Algebra K A] {x : A},
  IsAlgebraic K x → IsIntegral K x
